generalPerformanceLevels.source: Table 4: Statements of General Performance Level of KSSM Additional Mathematics (printed p.21-22)

levels.descriptor: Demonstrate basic knowledge such as stating a certain mathematical idea either verbally or non-verbally.
Demonstrate understanding such as explaining a certain mathematical concept either verbally or non-verbally.
Apply understanding of concepts and ideas in mathematics such as performing calculations, constructing tables and drawing graphs
Apply suitable knowledge and skills when using algorithms, formulae, procedures or basic methods in the context of problem solving involving simple routine problems.

Apply suitable knowledge and skills in new situations such as performing multi-step procedures, using representations based on different sources of information and reason out directly in the context of solving complex routine problems.

Apply suitable knowledge and skills such as using information based on investigation and modelling in solving complex problems situations; reason out at high level, form new approaches and strategies in the context of solving non-routine problems creatively.
